results.text:
# Today, we're excited to announce that Patientdesk.ai (YC W26) has raised $3.8M in total funding to build the AI brain behind every dental practice. | Emre Kaplaner · LinkedIn · 2026-04-28

**Emre Kaplaner**: Ortak Kurucu at Patientdesk.ai for 1 year 3 months with 5 years 1 month of total professional experience. Previous roles include Ortak Kurucu at LeadLake, Ortak Kurucu at ESO Marketing Automations, and Enterprise Resources Planning Project Managament Intern at Eaton. Based in United States [US].

---

Today, we're excited to announce that [Patientdesk.ai (YC W26)](https://linkedin.com/company/patientdesk-ai) has raised $3.8M in total funding to build the AI brain behind every dental practice.

Ten years ago, three kids from small cities across Turkey walked into Robert College in Istanbul. We had no connections, no network, no roadmap. Just a shared belief that we could build something meaningful together. We spent five years in that dorm, became best friends, and never stopped working on something.

After university in Amsterdam and Finland, we ended up inside dental practices, running a marketing agency and a call center, watching front desk staff drown in missed calls, manual insurance checks, and disconnected tools.

We didn't come from Silicon Valley. We didn't come from tech families. We just saw a broken industry and decided to fix it.

Two years later, that conviction took us to San Francisco, where we got into Y Combinator and turned that belief into a real company.

None of this would have been possible without the people who believed in us before it was obvious.

To [Gustaf Alströmer 🇺🇦](https://linkedin.com/in/gustafalstromer) and [James Evans](https://linkedin.com/in/james-evans-7086b3126), our YC partners, who showed up for us every single time. You made us feel like we had the whole YC behind us.

To [Ozgun Erdogan](https://linkedin.com/in/ozgune) and [Umur Cubukcu](https://linkedin.com/in/umurc), two people who became like big brothers to us and never hesitated to pick up the phone.

To [Eric Levine](https://linkedin.com/in/levineericj), [Jake Klamka](https://linkedin.com/in/jakeklamka), [Rami Essaid](https://linkedin.com/in/ramiessaid), and [Hassan Lantry](https://linkedin.com/in/hassan-lantry-008698108/en), thank you for the trust and the conviction.

To [Kutluhan Enişte](https://linkedin.com/in/kutluhaneniste), who never stopped checking in, never stopped pushing, and somehow always knew we had more in us.

To our incredible W26 batch mates, you made this the most memorable chapter of our lives.

And to our investors, Neil Maheshwari, [e2vc](https://linkedin.com/company/e2-vc), [Treeo VC](https://linkedin.com/company/treeo-vc), [TIBAS Ventures](https://linkedin.com/company/tibasventures), [Blast Club](https://linkedin.com/company/blast-club), and [Eksim Ventures](https://linkedin.com/company/eksim-ventures) thank you for backing this vision.

We're just getting started.

# Turkish founders' US-based Patientdesk.ai raises total funding to $3.8M

● Apr 2026

Patientdesk.ai, a San Francisco-based startup with Turkish founders, has raised $3.8 million in total funding following its graduation from Y Combinator's W26 programme. The round included participation from Y Combinator founding partners Gustaf Alströmer and James Evans, alongside Neil Maheshwari, e2vc, Treeo VC, TIBAS Ventures, Blast Club and Eksim Ventures. Founded by Emre Kaplaner, Öncel Özgül and Fikri Şan Köktaş, the company provides AI solutions that automate administrative and operational processes for dental clinics. The platform integrates with existing clinic workflows to digitalise repetitive tasks such as appointment scheduling and data entry. Working with over 60 clinics, Patientdesk.ai plans to use the funding to enhance operational efficiency, personalise patient experiences through AI, and expand its global presence.

Patientdesk.ai Raises $3.8 Million to Expand AI-Powered Dental Practice Operations Platform - VC Tavern

# Patientdesk.ai Raises $3.8 Million to Expand AI-Powered Dental Practice Operations Platform

 VC Tavern August 24, 2026 

Patientdesk.ai has raised $3.8 million in total funding to accelerate the development of its artificial intelligence platform for dental practices, expanding its mission to automate front-office and back-office operations across the healthcare sector. The San Francisco-based startup plans to use the capital to enhance its AI-powered patient coordination platform, deepen integrations with practice management systems, and broaden its suite of administrative tools beyond appointment scheduling into insurance verification, payments, and care coordination.

The funding includes a previously announced $1 million pre-seed round led by Y Combinator with participation from E2VC. Since that financing, Patientdesk.ai has continued raising additional capital, bringing its total funding to $3.8 million as the company scales its operations following strong customer adoption.

Founded by Oncel Ozgul, Emre Kaplaner, and Fikri San Koktas, Patientdesk.ai was created after the founders spent years working closely with dental clinics and observing the operational challenges faced by front-desk teams. They found that dental offices routinely struggled with unanswered phone calls, manual appointment scheduling, insurance verification delays, payment collection, and fragmented administrative workflows. These inefficiencies often resulted in missed revenue opportunities and increased workloads for practice staff.

To address these challenges, Patientdesk.ai developed an AI-native operating system specifically designed for dental practice administration. Rather than functioning solely as an AI receptionist, the platform manages multiple operational workflows, including answering inbound phone calls, qualifying prospective patients, booking appointments directly into practice management systems, verifying insurance eligibility during conversations, collecting payments, and sending automated reminders. The company aims to provide continuous front-desk coverage while reducing administrative burdens on healthcare providers.

Unlike general-purpose conversational AI tools, Patientdesk.ai focuses exclusively on dental workflows. Its platform integrates with existing practice management software, enabling clinics to automate complex administrative processes without replacing existing operational systems. According to the company, its AI agents understand patient context, insurance information, appointment availability, and payment requirements, allowing them to perform tasks traditionally handled by human receptionists.
